usage: The word 電費 (din6 fai3) is a noun referring to the electricity bill one pays for power consumption.
You can use 電費 as the object of a verb, for example, 'pay 電費' means to pay the electricity bill.
In conversations, 電費 often appears with numbers or amounts to specify the cost, e.g., '今日嘅電費幾錢？' (How much is today's electricity bill?).
It is frequently used in questions and statements discussing household expenses.
You can also use it in comparative sentences, like '呢個月嘅電費貴咗' (This month's electricity bill got more expensive).
